description: This file defines data structures and functions related to notification forwarding policies, including filtering modes, quiet hours, and rate limiting.

classes.name: NotificationPackageFilterMode
classes.description: An enum representing filtering modes for notification packages, allowing or blocking based on package lists.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the configuration for forwarding notifications, including filters, quiet hours, and rate limiting.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: A class providing rate-limiting for notification events within a sliding window.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Converts a string raw value to its corresponding NotificationPackageFilterMode enum value.

methods.name: allowsPackage
methods.description: Checks if a package is allowed according to the current filtering mode and package list.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Determines whether the current time (or specified time) falls within the configured quiet hours.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a time string to HH:MM format if valid.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Parses a time string to total minutes past midnight.

methods.name: allow
methods.description: Determines if a notification event is allowed based on rate limits within a time window.
